excerpts: This DPA sets forth the terms under which the Processor will process personal data on behalf of the Data Controller, ensuring compliance with: The UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR); The General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR), where applicable; Other applicable data protection or privacy legislation.

Ethos shall make available to User all information reasonably necessary to demonstrate compliance with this DPA and shall allow for and contribute to audits, subject to the following conditions: (a) Audits shall be limited in scope to the systems, facilities, records, and processing operations that are owned or controlled by Ethos and used to Process User’s Personal Data, and shall exclude the systems, facilities, premises, or data of any other customer, third party, or Sub-processor. (b) User shall provide at least thirty (30) days’ prior written notice; audits may be conducted no more than once annually, except following a confirmed Security Incident affecting User’s Personal Data or where required by a Regulatory Authority. (c) Audits shall be at User’s expense (including reimbursement of Ethos’s reasonable costs at Ethos’s then-current professional services rates), subject to reasonable confidentiality and security obligations, during business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Ethos’s operations or the rights of other customers. (d) In lieu of an on-site audit, User will accept Ethos’s then-current third-party audit reports (e.g., SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 certifications) where these reasonably address the matters User wishes to assess.

basis.reasoning: The DPA expressly states GDPR compliance. Its audit provision treats SOC 2 and ISO 27001 reports as examples rather than establishing that Ethos holds them, so those are excluded.

excerpts: [MCP server docs](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp): connect Claude Code, Claude, Cursor or Codex, sign in, example agent workflows, costs and the full tool list

MCP tools [list_benchmarks](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_benchmarks): Catalogue. Search the benchmark catalogue. [get_benchmark](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_benchmark): Catalogue. One benchmark's full catalogue entry, including its complete description. [get_benchmark_anatomy](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_benchmark_anatomy): Catalogue. What a benchmark actually asks of a model, shown on two real sample tasks. [list_models](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_models): Catalogue. Models you can evaluate. [list_judge_models](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_judge_models): Catalogue. Models that can grade answers (`judge_model` on the create tools), and the default. [list_harnesses](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_harnesses): Catalogue. Agent harnesses an agentic benchmark can run under (`harness_id` on run_benchmark). [estimate_eval](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-estimate_eval): Create and run. Price a benchmark eval before running it; nothing is created. [estimate_dataset_eval](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-estimate_dataset_eval): Create and run. Price an eval on your own data, a Hugging Face dataset or a copy of an eval before running it; nothing is created. [run_benchmark](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-run_benchmark): Create and run. Start an eval of one or more models on a benchmark. [run_eval_from_file](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-run_eval_from_file): Create and run. Start an eval on your own dataset: each row is one prompt, answered by every model and graded. [preview_huggingface_dataset](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-preview_huggingface_dataset): Create and run. Look at a Hugging Face dataset before running it: its configs, splits, columns (per config), row count and a few sample rows of the selected config. [run_eval_from_huggingface](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-run_eval_from_huggingface): Create and run. Start an eval on a Hugging Face dataset; each row is one prompt. [rerun_eval](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-rerun_eval): Create and run. Run a copy of an eval you own (or one in an organisation you administer), on the same prompts, as a new eval you own. [request_benchmark](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-request_benchmark): Create and run. Ask for a benchmark that is not in the library, and queue an eval of your models on it. [list_evals](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_evals): Manage. Evals you can see, newest first: your own, ones shared with you and (as an organisation owner or admin) the rest of your organisations'. [get_eval](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_eval): Manage. Everything about one eval: status, progress counts, settings, per-model summaries, the comparative report, cost cap, why it stopped, and its credit charge. [rename_eval](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-rename_eval): Manage. Rename an eval (its owner, or an owner/admin of its organisation). [cancel_eval](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-cancel_eval): Manage. Stop an eval that hasn't finished: pending or running. [retry_eval](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-retry_eval): Manage. Run a completed, failed or cancelled eval again, keeping the trials that already finished. [retry_failed_trials](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-retry_failed_trials): Manage. While an eval is still running, re-run the failed trials of models that have already finished. [generate_interim_report](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-generate_interim_report): Manage. Write the comparative report now, from the results so far, while the eval is still running. [get_eval_results](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_eval_results): Results. Per-model scores: average and raw score, latency, output length, completed count, a per-prompt score list (omitted on very large evals) and `winner_analysis`. [compare_evals](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-compare_evals): Results. Side-by-side scores for several evals (the UI's Compare page): each eval's name, status, benchmark and per-model average score, latency and completed count. [list_prompts](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_prompts): Results. Search and sort an eval's prompts, e.g. to find where one model beats another. [list_prompt_tags](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_prompt_tags): Results. Every tag and its values across an eval's prompts (for list_prompts `tags`). [get_prompt](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_prompt): Results. One prompt in full: its text, the expected answer or rubric, and every model's output, scores, judge explanation, tokens and latency. [list_trials](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_trials): Results. An agentic eval's trials and per-run statistics (success rate, pass@k, consensus, steps, time, tokens). [get_trial_trace](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_trial_trace): Results. One agent trial: reward, final answer, timings, the grader's verdict, the files and screenshots it produced plus the grader's own output files (fetch any of them with get_trial_file), and a page of its steps. [get_trial_step](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_trial_step): Results. One step of a trial in full: its message, tool calls and whole observation (text past 2 MB is cut). [get_trial_file](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_trial_file): Results. A screenshot (returned as an image), a file the agent produced, or a grader output file such as `verifier/reward-details.json` (returned as text, or base64 for binary files up to 5 MB). [get_trial_grader_logs](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_trial_grader_logs): Results. The grader's stdout and stderr for one trial: the best clue when a trial has no trajectory or a surprising score. [get_trial_download_link](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_trial_download_link): Results. One trial's trajectory or a download link for its workspace tarball. [export_eval](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-export_eval): Results. Export an eval's results. [get_sharing](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_sharing): Sharing. Who this eval is shared with: `collaborators` (people with an Ethos account; the full list for the eval's owner, the owners/admins of the eval's organisation and Ethos staff, only yourself otherwise) and its live `public_links` (null unless you own the eval). [get_share_link](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_share_link): Sharing. The eval's share link for people with an Ethos account (owner only). [accept_share_link](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-accept_share_link): Sharing. Accept a share link someone sent you, giving you read access to their eval. [remove_collaborator](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-remove_collaborator): Sharing. Remove a collaborator (owner only). [create_public_link](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-create_public_link): Sharing. Create a public link anyone can open without signing in: a read-only view of the eval's results and traces (owner only). [revoke_public_link](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-revoke_public_link): Sharing. Turn off a public link immediately (owner only). [set_screenshot_sharing](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-set_screenshot_sharing): Sharing. Let collaborators and public-link viewers see trial screenshots (owner only). [list_organizations](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_organizations): Organisations. Your organisations and your role in each (owner, admin or member). [create_organization](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-create_organization): Organisations. Create a team organisation, with you as its owner (when list_organizations says `can_create_team`). [rename_organization](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-rename_organization): Organisations. Rename a team organisation (owners and admins). [delete_organization](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-delete_organization): Organisations. Delete a team organisation (owners only). [leave_organization](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-leave_organization): Organisations. Leave a team organisation. [list_organization_members](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_organization_members): Organisations. A team organisation's `members` (with roles) and its pending and expired `invites` (owners and admins). [invite_to_organization](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-invite_to_organization): Organisations. Email someone an invite to a team organisation (owners and admins; only an owner can invite an owner). [resend_invite](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-resend_invite): Organisations. Send an expired invite again, as a new invite (owners and admins). [cancel_invite](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-cancel_invite): Organisations. Cancel a pending invite so its link stops working (owners and admins). [accept_organization_invite](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-accept_organization_invite): Organisations. Join an organisation from an invite you received. [change_member_role](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-change_member_role): Organisations. Change a member's role (owners and admins; only an owner grants or removes the owner role, and the last owner stays an owner). [remove_organization_member](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-remove_organization_member): Organisations. Remove a member (owners and admins; only an owner removes an owner). [get_credit_balance](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_credit_balance): Billing. An organisation's prepaid credit (owners and admins): balance, week-to-date spend, top-up packs, low-balance alert, auto top-up settings and saved card, and the newest ledger entries (10 unless you ask for up to 50). [get_usage](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-get_usage): Billing. What each eval cost the organisation, newest first (owners and admins): estimate, amount charged so far, and `state` (estimated = not started, reserved = running and charging as trials finish, settled = finished, released or skipped = nothing charged). [export_usage_csv](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-export_usage_csv): Billing. The organisation's eval charges for a date range as CSV (owners and admins), one row per eval at customer price: every eval whose charge settled in the range or that has any billing entry in it (a running eval's charges, a later correction or credit-back on an earlier eval). [list_billing_documents](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_billing_documents): Billing. The organisation's invoices and receipts (owners and admins), each with its total, status and links to view or download it. [update_billing_settings](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-update_billing_settings): Billing. Change the low-balance email and automatic top-up (owners and admins). [create_top_up_link](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-create_top_up_link): Billing. A secure checkout link to buy credit (owners and admins). [add_payment_card](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-add_payment_card): Billing. A secure link to save a card for automatic top-up (owners and admins). [list_saved_models](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-list_saved_models): Your settings. Your saved models ("Your models": your own OpenAI-compatible endpoints and Hugging Face checkpoints), yours and your organisations'. [save_model](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-save_model): Your settings. Save your own model so evals can call it. [test_saved_model](https://evals.askethos.com/mcp#tool-test_saved_model): Your settings. Call a saved model once to check it still answers.
